full_judgment: 8. Purpose of substitution of the heirs of a deceased plaintiff or defendant is to represent the estate of the deceased party in the proceedings. If some of the heirs of the deceased plaintiff or defendant are substituted and they appear in the suit or proceedings and without taking any objection about non-substitution of other heirs of the deceased party goes on proceeding with or contesting the suit that cannot make the decree passed ultimately in the suit nugatory or illegal for want of non-substitution of some of the heirs simply because the estate of the deceased plaintiff or defendant was well represented in the proceedings by substitution of some of the heirs whose names were known to the other party. In the instant case all the heirs of deceased defendant Ezaharul Hoq were substituted as defendant Nos. 1 (ka) to 1 (niya) in Title Suit No. 152 of 1974 within the period of limitation and defendant opposite party No. 12 Jashimuddin was not born at that time. Merely because the name of the plaintiff was written incorrectly in the substitution petition or defendant opposite party No. 10 Enamul Hoque was shown as major instead of minor contested decree in that suit against all the substituted heirs of Ezaharul Huq cannot be said to be illegal or void especially when natural guardian mother contested on behalf of all the minors. It is also now well settled that non- substitution of some of the heirs whose names could not be gathered in spite of due diligence or an heir not born at the time of substitution cannot make the decree ultimately passed in the suit illegal or void.
